title: A co-culture model system to quantify antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity in human breast cancer cells using an engineered natural killer cell line
protocol: Trypsinize and collect phoenix AMPHO cells in a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 210 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells to reach 1.2∗10^6 cells/mL in antibiotic-free medium.
Add 5 ml of antibiotic-free medium to a 10 cm cell culture plate pre-coated with 0.1% gelatin.
Prepare DNA lipofectamine2000 complexes by adding 12 μg of pMSCV_IRES_GFP_CD16a vector to 1.5 mL optimem in a 15 mL tube and mixing gently.
Incubate the mixture at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Combine diluted lipofectamine with diluted DNA by tapping gently.
Incubate the combined solution for 20 min at 20°C–25°C, mixing after 10 min.
Gently distribute the complexes in the plate using a cross-like movement.
Add 5 mL of cell suspension containing 6×10^6 cells to the plate.
Gently distribute the cells in the plate using a cross-like movement.
Place the plate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator.
Remove and discard the medium 24 hours after transfection.
Gently add 6 mL of KHYG-1 culture medium without IL-2 or antibiotics.
Incubate overnight at 32°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Collect all medium (around 6 mL) from the phoenix cells and place into a 50 mL tube after 48 hours.
Centrifuge the viral medium at 400 × g for 5 minutes to pellet cell debris.
Filter the viral medium using a 0.45 μm filter.
Add 2.8 μL of IL-2 (10 μg/mL) to 6 mL of viral medium for a final concentration of 4.6 ng/mL.
Equilibrate the viral medium to 20°C–25°C.
Transfer 2 mL of viral medium to a new 15 mL tube.
Add 1.6 μL of polybrene (stock 10 mg/mL) to achieve a final concentration of 8 μg/mL in the viral medium.
Count KHYG-1 cells and prepare two 15 mL tubes with 2×10^6 cells each.
Centrifuge at 210 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant from one tube and resuspend cells in 2 mL of viral medium containing polybrene.
Resuspend the cells in another tube in 2 mL of growth medium as a negative control.
Seed 2×10^6 cells in the middle wells of a 6-well plate.
Tape the plate to prevent spilling of the viruses.
Centrifuge the plate at 560 × g for 45 minutes with low acceleration and deceleration using swinging buckets.
Remove the tape from the plate and place it in a 32°C 5% CO2 incubator for 16–24 hours.
Collect control and transduced cells in a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 210 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Count the cells after removing the supernatant.
Seed the counted cells in antibiotic-free KHYG-1 medium to achieve a density of 0.5*10^6 cells/mL in a 6-well plate.
Place the seeded cells back into a 32°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Inactivate viral particles in discarded medium with bleach.
Collect control and transduced cells on day 5 in a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 210 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells on day 5.
Seed the transduced cells in 10 mL KHYG-1 medium with antibiotics into a 10 cm dish.
Place the seeded cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for recovery.
Start antibiotic selection of transduced and control cells on day 8.
Count transduced and control KHYG-1 cells on day 8.
Seed the counted cells at a density of 0.3*10^6 cells/mL in culture medium supplemented with 1 μg/mL puromycin.
Refresh medium with puromycin every 2–3 days.
Monitor cell death by resuspending and counting cells using trypan blue.
Seed 1 ml of 0.3∗10^6 cells/ml cell suspension in each well for a titration experiment.
Add varying concentrations of puromycin to different wells, ranging from 0 to 3 μg/ml.
Replace the medium after 2 days post-titration.
Assess cell death after 4 days and determine the optimal puromycin concentration.
Replace control cells with transduced cells in the culture after 7 days.
Expand transduced cells in KHYG-1 culture medium until freezing.
Freeze 2∗10^6 cells/mL in 20% FBS and 10% DMSO KHYG-1 culture medium.
Monitor CD16 expression on cell surface of KHYG-1 cells after transduction and selection.
Collect wild type KHYG-1 and transduced KHYG-1 cells in a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 250 × g for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL PBS.
Count the cells.
Move 6×10^4 cells into two 1.5 mL tubes per cell line.
Centrifuge at 250 × g for 2 min at 20°C–25°C.
Prepare antibody dilutions (in the dark, on ice).
Add 2 μL IgG-PE or CD16-PE in 50 μL PBS 1% BSA per sample.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL IgG-PE or CD16-PE dilution.
Incubate for 45 min at 4°C in the dark while rotating.
Wash 3 times with 200 μL PBS 1% BSA.
Resuspend cells in 0.5 mL PBS 1% BSA.
Transfer cells to a flow cytometry tube.
Analyze GFP and PE signal by flow cytometry using the LSRFortessa.
Prepare and plate effector and target cells for the ADCC assay.
Perform a serial dilution of trastuzumab to determine the optimal antibody concentration.
Use 1 μg/mL of trastuzumab as the lowest concentration providing highest cytotoxicity in co-culture assays with KHYG-1 CD16+ cells and BT474 target cells at a 5:1 effector:target ratio.
Use this concentration for comparing different target and effector cell lines and ratios.
Mix medium only in wells A–C of column 1 on each plate.
Mix medium with lysis buffer in wells D–F of column 1 on each plate.
Culture target cells with antibody in column 3 to measure spontaneous release.
Lysate target cells and measure the maximum release in column 4.
Culture natural killer cells with antibody in column 2 to measure effector spontaneous release.
Co-culture effector and target cells without antibody in column 5 for nonspecific cytotoxicity measurement.
Co-culture effector and target cells with antibody in column 6 for antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) assessment.
Plate target cell lines.
Add medium or antibody to wells as indicated.
Seed KHYG-1 CD16+ cells at a fixed ratio for antibody titrations experiments or at different effector:target ratios.
Add lysis buffer to specified wells 45 minutes before the end of the co-culture incubation.
Note: To minimize pipetting errors and produce more reliable results, use a multichannel pipet for transferring cells, antibody or medium to the 96-well plate.
Use triplicates for each co-culture condition.
Incubate target or effector cells with trastuzumab during a 24 h culture period.
Normalize LDH release to cells cultured without antibody (n = 3).
Measure LDH release of 1*10^3 to 4*10^4 BT474, MCF7, and MDAMB361 cells with or without lysis buffer.
Incubate KHYG-1 CD16+ and BT474 alone or in co-culture for 6 h.
Incubate KHYG-1 CD16+ and BT474 alone or in co-culture for 24 h.
Enhance antibody-dependent KHYG-1 CD16+ mediated cell killing by increasing assay time from 6 h to 24 h for the BT474 cell line.
Use a range of 5*10^4 to 2*10^5 target cells per well.
Calculate the number of cells needed for the experiment taking into account that 1*10^4 target cells will be seeded per well in a 96-well plate.
Prepare target cells suspension.
Harvest target cells (BT474, MCF7 or MDA-MB-361).
Centrifuge at 210 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in ADCC assay medium and count.
Prepare a cell suspension of target cells of 2*10^5 cells/mL.
Plate 50 μL of target cell suspension in the appropriate wells of a round bottom 96-well plate to get 1*10^4 cells per well.
Add 50 μL ADCC assay medium to wells without target cells.
Prepare antibody dilutions.
Prepare a 10× dilution of trastuzumab for a stock concentration of 2.1 mg/mL.
Prepare 2× concentrated working stocks of trastuzumab because the trastuzumab will be diluted 1:2 when added to the wells containing 50 μL medium.
Prepare a 4 μg/mL working stock by adding 1.4 μL trastuzumab (2.1 mg/mL) to 750 μL ADCC assay medium.
Add 175, 154, 107, 225, 116 and 145 μL ADCC assay medium to respective wells of a 96-well plate.
Add 320 μL of the 4 μg/mL working stock to an eighth well and serially dilute into the next well by transferring specified volumes sequentially.
Prepare a 2 μg/mL working stock by adding 2.4 μL trastuzumab (2.1 mg/mL) to 2.5 mL ADCC assay medium.
Add 50 μL of the antibody working stocks to appropriate wells and 50 μL ADCC assay medium to wells without antibody.
Place the plate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator for 30 min.
Collect effector cells in a 15 mL tube, centrifuge at 210 × g for 5 min, resuspend in ADCC assay medium, and count.
Prepare a cell suspension of 1*10^5 cells/mL for a 1:1 effector:target ratio.
Resuspend 3*10^5 cells in 3 mL assay medium.
Plate 1*10^4 effector cells (100 μL) per well on the plate containing two cell lines.
Prepare a cell suspension of 5*10^5 cells/mL for a 5:1 effector:target ratio.
Resuspend 1.5*10^6 cells in 3 mL assay medium.
Plate 5*10^4 effector cells (100 μL) per well on the plate containing two cell lines.
Prepare a cell suspension of 1*10^6 cells/mL for a 10:1 effector:target ratio.
Resuspend 3*10^6 cells in 3 mL assay medium.
Plate 1*10^5 effector cells per well on the plate containing two cell lines.
Add 100 μL of effector cell suspension to the appropriate wells.
Add 100 μL of assay medium to the wells without effector cells.
Centrifuge the plate at 250 × g for 4 min.
Place the plate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator for 6 or 24 hours.
Add 20 μL lysis buffer to the maximum release wells with target cells and three wells with only medium, 45 minutes before the end of the incubation time.
Thaw cytotox96 reagent and keep on ice in the dark.
Centrifuge the ADCC plate at 250 × g for 4 min.
Transfer 50 μL supernatant to a fresh 96-well plate.
Add 50 μL cytotox96 reagent to each well.
Incubate 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
Add 50 μL stop solution (1M acetic acid).
Pop large bubbles using a syringe needle.
Measure absorbance at 490 nm within 1 h using a plate reader.
Calculate the average signal of the medium only wells.
Subtract the average medium background from all wells, except the maximum LDH release wells.
For the maximum LDH release wells, subtract the average medium + lysis buffer background.
Calculate cytotoxicity.

Calculate the average of the nonspecific cytotoxicity wells.
Calculate the average of the ADCC wells.

Calculate the cytotoxicity using the formula provided.
